text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — we're enabling nova-13b-v2 in the model catalog tonight during the EU change window 00:30-01:30 UTC. Plan: staggered canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with fallback ordering set to [nova-quant, nova-13b-v1, default-small].

Raj Patel: Ack, I'll own telemetry and the canary gates (errors, perf, regressions). Posting eval sets to run. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Automated: canary rollout initiated for model:nova-13b-v2 (slot: canary-1). Canary traffic: 0.5% -> ramp script active. Logs: /deploy/logs/3301234567/canary.

Linh Tran: Can we pin nova-13b-v2 for top-tier orgs during ramp? Suggest pin list: [enterprise-alpha, beta-inc] so they don't flip during split traffic.

Maria Chen: Yes pin for them. Use the deploybot pin command below. Also run smoke evals A+B before 10% step.

deploy-bot: Command: `/deploybot pin model nova-13b-v2 --customers enterprise-alpha,beta-inc`

AlexG: Ops thresholds proposal: error rate > 1.5% OR p99 latency > 750ms during canary => auto rollback. Add a manual throttle check: if either triggers, hold 5m and escalate to oncall if persisting.

SRE-Jamie: I'll set infra circuit-breakers: GPU util > 85% or queue depth > 120 => throttle canary and alert. Also please add logging of KV cache hits for replica comparison.

Maria Chen: Fallback ordering config we will push to catalog-service:```
fallback_order:
  - nova-quant
  - nova-13b-v1
  - default-small
```

Raj Patel: Eval results link: https://console.redwood-internal/evals/3301234567 — running prompt sets: latency-sensitive, hallucination-check, pricing-safety. Will report t+10m and t+30m.

Product-Ops: Release note draft: "nova-13b-v2: improved long-context latency and tokenization fix for code completions. Performance-focused rollout; watch for edge-case decoding changes."

AlexG: Rollback playbook summary: if auto-rollback triggers, deploy-bot will pin to nova-13b-v1 and shift traffic back. Manual rollback: tag PR with `rollback:nova-13b-v2`, create incident channel, and call out stakeholders.

SRE-Jamie: If telemetry is noisy, delay next ramp by 10m. I'll post infra snapshot each step.

Linh Tran: Confirmed pin applied for enterprise-alpha. beta-inc pending consent (PM approving).

deploy-bot: Canary update: t+12m: errors 0.6%, p99 410ms, KV hit delta +2%. No automatic actions.

Maria Chen: Good start. Keep comms here. If anyone wants to abort, reply with `ABORT` and reason, then @oncall and @product-ops will join.

AlexG: One more: ensure fallback variants are available in region EU-WEST1 before moving past 10%.

Raj Patel: Noted — running region availability check now.

deploy-bot: Final note: scheduled cleanup at +2h if rollout completes (remove temporary canary slots).
